Magnus Laptop Backpack for 39.62 cm (15.6 Inch) Laptop – Grey

The Magnus Laptop Backpack for 39.62 cm (15.6 inch) Laptop is thoughtfully designed for modern professionals, office-going men and women, and daily commuters who value comfort, durability, and style. Crafted in a versatile grey color, this backpack blends seamlessly with formal and casual outfits, making it an excellent choice for work, meetings, business travel, and everyday use.

Designed to meet the needs of busy professionals, the Magnus laptop backpack features a cushioned laptop bag compartment that securely fits laptops up to 15.6 inches. The padding helps protect your device from minor bumps and impacts during daily travel, ensuring peace of mind whether you’re commuting by metro, bus, or car.

The front zipper compartment adds practicality and quick accessibility. It allows you to store frequently used items such as chargers, cables, notebooks, pens, wallets, or documents without opening the main compartment. This thoughtful design makes the Magnus backpack ideal for office use, meetings, and short business trips.

The Magnus Laptop Bag Backpack for 39.62 cm (15.6 inch) Laptop is not just about storage; it is built for comfortable daily carrying. The backpack comes with a sturdy top handle that allows it to be comfortably carried by hand when needed. In addition, the extra handle for easy pull and carry provides added convenience, especially in crowded spaces or during travel.

The ergonomic design ensures balanced weight distribution, making it suitable for long office hours and daily commutes. Whether you are an office-going professional, a corporate executive, or a working student, this backpack adapts easily to your routine.

Smart Storage for Office and Professional Use

This office laptop is designed to help you stay organized throughout the day. The cushioned laptop compartment safely holds your device, while additional space inside allows you to store files, folders, diaries, lunch boxes, or accessories. The front zipper compartment ensures that your essentials remain within easy reach at all times.

The sleek and minimal grey finish makes the Magnus suitable for both men and women. Its professional look makes it ideal for office meetings, presentations, conferences, and daily work travel. The durable construction ensures long-lasting use, making it a reliable companion for everyday professional needs.
